### Function
- 「... ~ ...」*qualified noun marker*
- marks the noun that is qualified by the preceding adjective/s
### Etymology
#### Glyph
- the counterpart to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Grammar/an\|an]] (adjective marker).
- the line of the label is attached to a thing but is cut off to signify that [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Grammar/an\|an]] continues it.
- Related to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Grammar/pi\|pi]] (possessor marker)
#### Sound
- Related to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Grammar/pi\|pi]] (possessor marker)
- *a priori:* p=sudden (sprouting out of noun)
